::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/currencies"}
#docs
The base currency first (`is_base`, no rate), then every enabled or rated currency with its rate and provenance.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The items. |
| `data.object` | `string` | The object type. |
| `data.currency` | `string` | The currency's ISO-4217 code. |
| `data.is_base` | `boolean` | True if this is the business's default currency. |
| `data.enabled` | `boolean` | In the business's enabled currency list |
| `data.rate` | `string` | The exchange rate to the default currency. |
| `data.source` | `string` | Where the rate comes from: `manual` or `auto`. One of `manual`, `auto`. |
| `data.updated_at` | `string` | When the rate was last updated (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `data.provider` | `string` | The service that provides the automatic rate. |
| `data.last_error` | `string` | The last error from fetching the automatic rate, if any. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | A list of currency objects |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/currencies" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```

```json [200 OK]
  "object": "list",
  "data": [
    {
      "object": "currency",
      "currency": "EUR",
      "is_base": false,
      "enabled": false,
      "rate": "0.920000",
      "source": "manual"
    }
  ]
}
```
